summary: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Fourteenth Amendment to its existing revolving credit facility. The amendment extends the maturity date for consenting lenders with $3.67 billion in commitments to August 20, 2031, and establishes a new class of MarketAxess Revolving Commitments of $1.5 billion to be borrowed in connection with the MarketAxess Acquisition, contingent on limited conditionality. Total commitments remain at $3.9 billion. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. The reference to the MarketAxess Acquisition indicates upcoming M&A but is not the subject of this filing. What to watch: details of the MarketAxess Acquisition in future filings.
